PublicGoodsAgent.purpose: LLM-driven participant in repeated public goods game; tracks own contribution and payoff history and builds contribution prompts.

PublicGoodsEnvironment.purpose: Runs simultaneous 24-agent public goods rounds, computes baseline public-goods payoffs, updates histories, and logs results.

functions.main: Creates 24 agents, environment, runs 30 public-goods rounds, and saves config/log/stat/state/result JSON outputs.

detected_capabilities.current_action_space: Each agent chooses an integer public-goods contribution from 0 to initial_endowment/max_contribution.
detected_capabilities.current_payoff_formula: private_savings = initial_endowment - contribution; public_pool_gain = total_contribution * public_pool_multiplier; gain_per_agent = public_pool_gain / num_agents; payoff = private_savings + gain_per_agent.
detected_capabilities.current_history_visibility: Agents currently see only aggregate prior total contribution and public fund gain, not pseudonym-linked individual contribution histories.

baseline_invariants.rule: Keep all baseline game and experiment settings unchanged; add only the mechanism.

mechanism_summary.name: Reputation-coupled indirect reciprocity
mechanism_summary.summary: Add stable pseudonym-linked public histories and an indirect-reciprocity help decision stage in which donors observe a receiver's prior public-goods contributions and prior help decisions. Public-goods contributions therefore become reputation-relevant and can influence later help received. The baseline public-goods payoff formula must be computed unchanged first; indirect-reciprocity help costs and benefits are added only as a separate mechanism payoff adjustment.

required_code_changes.description: Extend each agent with stable pseudonym-linked histories needed by the reputation mechanism while preserving existing public-goods state variables.

add_agent_fields: self.pseudonym: use the existing stable self._name unless a separate alias is desired; do not randomize across rounds.
self.pg_contribution_history: list of dicts with round, contribution, baseline_pg_payoff.
self.ir_giving_history: list of dicts with round, receiver_id, receiver_name, helped, cost, explanation.
self.ir_receiving_history: list of dicts with round, donor_id, donor_name, helped, benefit.
self.reputation_or_image_score: numeric derived score updated after each round.
details.update_state_guidance: Keep the existing _my_history and _outcome_history updates intact. Add optional keyword-compatible fields or create a separate method for appending public-goods contribution history so existing calls do not break.
details.get_state_summary_guidance: Return existing fields plus pg_contribution_history, ir_giving_history, ir_receiving_history, reputation_or_image_score, total_help_given, total_help_received, and total_mechanism_payoff_adjustment.
do_not_change: existing outcome_history semantics except it may store final payoff after mechanism adjustment if clearly logged separately

acceptance_criteria: Agent initialization still works with the same constructor signature.
Existing contribution histories remain available exactly as before.
Each agent state JSON includes public-goods contribution history and indirect-reciprocity giving/receiving history.
Agent names remain stable across all rounds and can serve as pseudonyms.

required_code_changes.description: Maintain a complete public ledger of pseudonym-linked public-goods contributions and indirect-reciprocity help decisions for use in prompts and analysis.

add_environment_fields: self.public_reputation_ledger: dict keyed by agent_id with name, pg_contributions, ir_given, ir_received, reputation_score.
self.ir_logs: list of per-round indirect reciprocity decision logs.
self.reputation_scores_by_round: list of per-round reputation score snapshots.
details.ledger_update_timing: After all public-goods contributions are collected and baseline public-goods payoffs are computed, append each agent's current contribution to the ledger. After the indirect-reciprocity stage, append help decisions and update reputation scores.
details.score_formula_guidance: Use a transparent derived score based only on visible histories, for example normalized average public-goods contribution plus help-giving rate. The score is informational and analytical; it should not directly alter public-goods payoffs except through agents' help decisions.
details.visibility_guidance: The ledger is public prompt context, not private hidden state.

acceptance_criteria: For every completed round, the ledger contains one public-goods contribution entry for each agent.
For every completed indirect-reciprocity opportunity, the ledger records donor, receiver, help decision, and payoff adjustment.
Reputation scores are reproducible from logged histories.

required_code_changes.description: Revise public-goods contribution prompts so agents know their contributions are pseudonym-linked and may be visible to others during later help decisions, without changing the contribution range or public-goods payoff rules.

details.history_display_change: Keep the existing aggregate history lines. Add a concise public reputation section showing pseudonym-linked prior public-goods contributions and prior indirect-reciprocity help decisions for all agents, or a bounded recent-history version if prompts become too long.
prompt_additions: Tell the agent its stable pseudonym/name.
Tell the agent that prior public-goods contributions and help decisions are visible to other participants in later indirect-reciprocity help decisions.
Tell the agent that the public-goods payoff rule remains: contributions are multiplied by the public_pool_multiplier and divided equally among all num_agents players.
Do not instruct the agent to follow any particular strategy; only describe the informational/reputational consequences.
details.bounded_memory_guidance: Use the existing memory_size parameter to limit displayed detailed rows if needed, but preserve full logs in machine-readable state.
do_not_change: The current LLM parsing behavior for contribution amounts except as necessary for robustness.

acceptance_criteria: Contribution prompts include the agent's stable pseudonym.
Contribution prompts explicitly state that contribution history can affect later reputation/help decisions.
Contribution prompts still state the unchanged baseline endowment, multiplier, number of players, and contribution range.
No baseline game parameter is replaced by paper-specific values.

required_code_changes.operation: add new indirect-reciprocity help decision method
required_code_changes.description: Add a new LLM decision method for donors to choose whether to help a receiver after observing the receiver's visible reputation/history.

details.new_method_signature: async def choose_ir_help_action(self, receiver_agent, receiver_visible_history: dict, ir_help_cost: float, ir_help_benefit: float, current_round: int) -> tuple[bool, str]
details.action_options: Binary help decision: help/give or do not help. Parse yes/no, help/no help, or 1/0 robustly. Default to no help on parsing or LLM failure.
prompt_context: Identify donor pseudonym and receiver pseudonym.
Display receiver's prior public-goods contribution history.
Display receiver's prior indirect-reciprocity giving history.
Display receiver's current reputation/image score if implemented.
State that choosing help costs the donor ir_help_cost mechanism coins and gives the receiver ir_help_benefit mechanism coins.
Ask for HELP or NO_HELP first, followed by a brief explanation.
details.important_constraint: The help action is an added mechanism stage; it must not change the public-goods contribution action range or baseline public-goods payoff calculation.

acceptance_criteria: Each call returns a boolean help decision and explanation.
Invalid or unparsable LLM responses are handled without crashing and default to no help.
The receiver prompt context contains visible public-goods and help histories.
No public-goods contribution is requested in this method.

required_code_changes.operation: add within-group donor-receiver pairing for mechanism stage
required_code_changes.description: Create indirect-reciprocity donor-receiver opportunities within the existing 24-agent group after the public-goods contribution stage, without changing the baseline group size or main round count.

details.pairing_rule: Use all existing agents as donors once per round. Assign each donor one receiver from the same existing group, excluding self. Use the existing RANDOM_SEED/random module for reproducibility. A simple shuffled rotation is acceptable.
details.preserve_architecture: Do not split the 24 agents into paper-style groups of 6. Do not change the number of public-goods rounds. Do not add extra outer-loop rounds.
details.timing: Within each existing run_interaction call: collect PGG contributions, compute baseline PGG payoffs, update visible PGG ledger, then run IR help decisions and apply mechanism payoff adjustments.
details.alternative_if_prompt_cost_too_high: Optionally allow a mechanism_config flag ir_stage_enabled=True and ir_pairings_per_round='all_donors_once'; default should implement the mechanism when enabled, while preserving baseline settings.

acceptance_criteria: There are still exactly EXPERIMENT_SETTINGS['num_rounds'] calls to env.run_interaction per experiment.
All pairings occur among the existing env.agents list.
No agent is paired with itself as receiver.
The baseline all-agent public-goods group remains intact.

required_code_changes.operation: apply indirect-reciprocity payoff adjustment after baseline payoff
required_code_changes.description: Preserve the existing public-goods payoff formula exactly, then add separate help cost/benefit adjustments from the indirect-reciprocity mechanism.

details.baseline_formula_preservation: Keep total_contribution, public_pool_gain, gain_per_agent, private_savings, and baseline total_gain calculation unchanged.
new_payoff_fields: baseline_pg_payoffs: payoff from unchanged public-goods formula.
ir_payoff_adjustments: per-agent sum of benefits received minus help costs paid.
details.mechanism_parameters: Add mechanism-specific parameters such as ir_help_cost and ir_help_benefit in a nested mechanism_config or environment attributes. These are not replacements for baseline initial_endowment or public_pool_multiplier. Because the paper excerpt does not specify exact IR cost/benefit values, make them explicit and logged. Avoid using paper settings as replacements for baseline settings.
details.suggested_default_handling: If defaults are required, choose small documented mechanism-only values and log them; alternatively require explicit values in mechanism_config. Do not derive them by changing initial_endowment.
details.state_update_guidance: When updating existing agent outcome history, either store final_payoff while also logging baseline_pg_payoff separately, or add a separate final_outcome field. The machine-readable round log must preserve both baseline and final values.
details.no_direct_reputation_bonus: Do not add a direct monetary bonus for reputation score. Reputation affects payoffs only through donor help decisions.

acceptance_criteria: For a no-help round, final_payoffs equal baseline_pg_payoffs for every agent.
For each help decision, donor final payoff decreases by ir_help_cost and receiver final payoff increases by ir_help_benefit.
Baseline public-goods payoff components remain numerically identical to the original implementation for the same contribution vector.
Logs include baseline payoff, IR adjustment, and final payoff separately.

required_code_changes.description: Add round-level logs and aggregate metrics needed to evaluate reputation-coupled indirect reciprocity while retaining existing log fields.

metric_definitions.contribution_decay: mean contribution in final public-goods round minus mean contribution in first public-goods round, or a list of round-to-round changes.
metric_definitions.overall_help_rate: number of HELP decisions divided by total IR decisions.
metric_definitions.average_help_received_by_reputation_scor: summary association table or bins comparing receiver reputation score to help probability.
metric_definitions.total_profit_by_agent: sum of final_payoffs across rounds by agent pseudonym.

acceptance_criteria: Existing game_logs JSON consumers can still read original fields.
New IR and reputation fields are present in every round log.
Game summary includes cooperation and mechanism metrics.
Metrics can be computed from saved logs without re-running the experiment.

required_code_changes.operation: add nested mechanism configuration without altering baseline settings
required_code_changes.description: Record mechanism-specific settings separately from baseline public-goods experiment settings.

details.environment_constructor_guidance: Either pass mechanism_config to PublicGoodsEnvironment as an optional new parameter with a default, or set environment attributes after construction. Preserve existing positional parameters and behavior where possible.
details.save_guidance: Saved experiment_config.json should include the nested mechanism settings so cost/benefit assumptions are transparent.

acceptance_criteria: Baseline settings in EXPERIMENT_SETTINGS are unchanged.
Mechanism settings are clearly nested and labeled as mechanism-only.
The experiment repeat count remains unchanged in the __main__ block.
The results config file records the mechanism settings.

required_code_changes.operation: save extended agent and interaction outputs
required_code_changes.description: Ensure existing output files include new reputation and indirect-reciprocity data while preserving their current filenames and core fields.

details.additional_optional_file: Optionally save reputation_metrics{experiment_index}.json if the summary becomes too large, but do not remove existing files.

acceptance_criteria: game_logs, game_stats, agent_states, and interaction_results are still saved.
New fields are serializable to JSON.
No existing output file is renamed or omitted.

new_state_variables.name: pseudonym
new_state_variables.description: Stable public identifier; use existing agent.name unless a separate alias is introduced.

new_state_variables.name: pg_contribution_history
new_state_variables.description: Per-round public-goods contributions linked to the agent pseudonym.

new_state_variables.name: ir_giving_history
new_state_variables.description: Indirect-reciprocity help decisions made by the agent as donor.

new_state_variables.name: ir_receiving_history
new_state_variables.description: Indirect-reciprocity help outcomes received by the agent as receiver.

new_state_variables.name: reputation_or_image_score
new_state_variables.description: Derived visible score summarizing public-goods contribution history and help-giving history.

new_state_variables.name: public_reputation_ledger
new_state_variables.description: Public pseudonym-linked ledger of all agents' public-goods and indirect-reciprocity histories.

new_state_variables.name: ir_logs
new_state_variables.description: Full record of donor-receiver pairings, help decisions, explanations, and payoff adjustments.

new_state_variables.name: mechanism_config
new_state_variables.description: Nested mechanism-only configuration for IR help cost, benefit, pairing rule, and visibility.

new_logs.name: baseline_pg_payoffs
new_logs.description: Payoffs from the unchanged public-goods formula before indirect-reciprocity adjustments.

new_logs.name: ir_pairings
new_logs.description: Donor-receiver pairs used in the indirect-reciprocity stage.

new_logs.name: ir_decisions
new_logs.description: For each donor, receiver, help/no-help decision, parsed response, and explanation.

new_logs.name: ir_payoff_adjustments
new_logs.description: Per-agent mechanism payoff adjustment from help costs and benefits.

new_logs.name: final_payoffs
new_logs.description: Baseline public-goods payoff plus indirect-reciprocity adjustment.

new_logs.name: public_reputation_snapshot
new_logs.description: Visible history and reputation score snapshot after the round.

new_logs.name: mechanism
new_logs.description: Nested configuration describing the reputation-coupled indirect-reciprocity mechanism and its explicit cost/benefit assumptions.

new_metrics.name: mean_public_goods_contribution
new_metrics.definition: Average public-goods contribution per round: total_contribution / num_agents.

new_metrics.name: contribution_decay
new_metrics.definition: Change in mean public-goods contribution over time, including first-round to final-round difference.

new_metrics.name: overall_help_rate
new_metrics.definition: HELP decisions divided by total indirect-reciprocity decisions.

new_metrics.name: help_received_by_reputation

new_metrics.name: average_ir_adjustment

new_metrics.name: reputation_score_by_round
new_metrics.definition: Reputation/image score for each pseudonym after each round.

tests_or_checks.name: baseline_parameter_invariance_check
tests_or_checks.description: Verify num_agents=24, initial_endowment=20, public_pool_multiplier=9.6, num_rounds=30, and NUM_EXPERIMENT_RUNS=3 remain unchanged.

tests_or_checks.name: baseline_payoff_equivalence_check
tests_or_checks.description: For a fixed contribution vector, compare baseline_pg_payoffs against the original formula: initial_endowment - contribution + total_contribution * public_pool_multiplier / num_agents.

tests_or_checks.name: no_help_payoff_check
tests_or_checks.description: Force all IR decisions to NO_HELP and verify final_payoffs equal baseline_pg_payoffs and ir_payoff_adjustments are all zero.

tests_or_checks.name: single_help_payoff_check
tests_or_checks.description: Force one donor to HELP one receiver and verify donor adjustment is -ir_help_cost, receiver adjustment is +ir_help_benefit, and other agents have zero IR adjustment.

tests_or_checks.name: pairing_validity_check
tests_or_checks.description: Verify each donor is an existing agent, each receiver is an existing agent, and donor_id != receiver_id for all IR pairings.

tests_or_checks.name: round_count_check
tests_or_checks.description: Verify each experiment still produces exactly 30 interaction logs and the main loop still calls run_interaction once per public-goods round.

tests_or_checks.name: history_visibility_check
tests_or_checks.description: After at least two rounds, inspect an IR prompt or generated receiver_visible_history to confirm it includes receiver prior PGG contributions and IR giving history.

tests_or_checks.name: json_serialization_check
tests_or_checks.description: Run one short mocked experiment or dry-run serialization path and verify game_logs, game_stats, agent_states, and interaction_results can be dumped to JSON with new fields.

tests_or_checks.name: llm_parse_fallback_check
tests_or_checks.description: Mock invalid IR LLM responses and verify choose_ir_help_action defaults safely to NO_HELP without raising an exception.

tests_or_checks.name: metric_consistency_check
tests_or_checks.description: Verify mean_public_goods_contribution, help_rate, total_profit, and reputation snapshots are derivable from logged round data.

risks.risk: The source excerpt does not specify exact indirect-reciprocity help cost and benefit values.
risks.mitigation: Use explicit mechanism_config parameters, log them, and do not treat them as baseline game constants.

risks.risk: Adding an IR decision for every donor every round increases LLM calls substantially.
risks.mitigation: Keep the mechanism stage configurable and use bounded reputation-history prompt context while preserving full machine-readable logs.

risks.risk: Prompt context may become too long when displaying 24 agents' histories over 30 rounds.
risks.mitigation: Display concise reputation summaries plus recent detailed history; preserve full ledger in logs.

risks.risk: Reputation score formula is not specified in the paper excerpt.
risks.mitigation: Make reputation score a transparent derived metric from visible histories and avoid direct payoff effects from the score.

risks.risk: The original paper alternated PGG and IR games over a different group size and round schedule.
risks.mitigation: Do not import paper group size or round schedule; implement the mechanism within each existing baseline round.

risks.risk: Existing outcome_history semantics may become ambiguous if final payoffs include IR adjustments.
risks.mitigation: Log baseline_pg_payoff, ir_adjustment, and final_payoff separately and document which value update_state stores.

out_of_scope: Changing baseline num_agents from 24 to the paper's group size 6.
Changing baseline num_rounds from 30 to the paper's 20 rounds.
Changing NUM_EXPERIMENT_RUNS from 3 to the paper's 19 groups/runs.
Replacing the baseline all-agent public-goods group architecture with paper-specific six-person groups.
Implementing the paper's exact alternating 16-round then terminal-round schedule if doing so would change the baseline round count or main experiment structure.
Using paper experimental parameter values that are absent from the excerpt as if they were known.
Adding direct monetary rewards for reputation score independent of actual help decisions.
Changing the public-goods contribution action range or baseline public-goods payoff formula.
Changing baseline number of agents, initial endowment, multiplier/MPCR/payoff constants, number of rounds, experiment repeat count, or group/matching architecture.
